node_definition.done_when: A test counts aggregations through a counter it installs. Ten reads with unchanged inputs aggregate once. A run launched, promoted or discarded between two reads changes the next read's count to the new value. The cache disabled, the negative control, aggregates on every read. The roadmap build and section view wall times at base and head are stated as numbers from a read-only measurement script over this repository's real ledger and live pointers. tests/test_section_attempts_are_tool_owned.py and the roadmap and read-view test files are recorded as flat baseline_suite and after_suite records.
node_definition.goal: Make section-contract-and-computed-impl §13 hold as its section states. The derived section attempt aggregation in reckon/mcp_views.py (section_attempts_by_plan and the narrowed per-section form) is cached against an identity that changes whenever its inputs do: the ledger's index version or newest run file, plus the live-pointer set's names and modification times. A read with unchanged inputs reuses the cached result, guarded by a lock because the server serves reads from threads.
